scope: Structured DROID SequenceExample lineage audit v3
summary: All payload integrity checks passed, but the OpenCV video backend could not software-decode the LeRobot AV1 files and stopped at episode 21 frame 5046.
evidence: The decoder emitted repeated AV1 missing-sequence-header/pixel-format diagnostics.
The run failed before any frame-alignment metric was accepted.
/usr/bin/ffmpeg subsequently decoded the same frame through libdav1d to the expected 172,800 BGR bytes.
lessons: AV1 lineage audits must pin an explicit software decoder rather than relying on environment-dependent OpenCV codec support.
limitations: The attempt produced no pixel-lineage conclusion.
next_actions: Use pinned ffmpeg/libdav1d segment decoding and rerun in a new directory.
